notes: Auburn's per-course syllabi are not public (Canvas / Simple Syllabus). Auburn's Biggio Center publishes instructor-level AI syllabus statement templates (open, moderate, strict use); that is a university-level resource, not a course syllabus, so nothing was collected from it. The degree plan also requires COMP 1100 AI Fundamentals to Application (sophomore year), noted for context only. The eng.auburn.edu host refused connections during collection.
